Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice of part sale A shows.

Step 2:

  • The invoice's menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The Issue Credit window opens.

Step 4:

  • The Parts to return list shows part A at $20.00 and part B at $15.00.
  • Part A carries a grey "Inactive" tag right after its part number; part B has none.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and no credit is issued.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R13: “A credit on any invoice, from a part sale or a work order, lists the parts sold on the invoice, active or inactive. A part that is now inactive carries the grey "Inactive" tag beside its part number.”
  • Key Decisions: “Inactive parts stay out of new work, and stay in returns and credits. A retired part on a past sale still has to be returnable to the vendor and creditable to the customer.”
